modules.name: Family Management
modules.description: Lets residents record family members and gives admins and managers counts of families and members.

modules.name: Notice Board
modules.description: Lets admins and society managers post events and celebrations to projects.

modules.name: Customer Registration and Approvals
modules.description: Covers registration of owners and tenants and the approval rights given to committee members.

modules.name: Amenities
modules.description: Shows residents how many people are currently in the gym or pool.

modules.name: Neighbours
modules.description: Lets residents see the names of their same-floor neighbours.

requirements.title: Residents add family members once
requirements.description: A Resident can add their family members once so the society knows who lives in their flat (US-15, FR-FAM-02).

requirements.title: Families by age group and owner/tenant per project
requirements.description: A Raghuvir Admin can see families by age group and owners vs tenants per project, to plan events, facilities and senior care (US-16, FR-FAM-10).

requirements.title: Member counts by building
requirements.description: A Society Manager can see member counts by building to plan society events and needs for the project (US-17, FR-FAM-14).

requirements.title: Post event to selected projects only
requirements.description: A Raghuvir Admin can post an event to selected projects only so only the right projects see it (US-18, FR-NB-02).

requirements.title: Post celebrations on project notice board
requirements.description: A Society Manager can post celebrations on their project's notice board so everyone in the project gets the news in one place (US-19, FR-NB-03).

requirements.title: Tenants register and use app like owners
requirements.description: A Tenant can register and use the app like an owner to raise complaints and book facilities where they live (US-20, FR-CUS-06).

requirements.title: Live gym and pool occupancy
requirements.description: A Resident can see how many people are in the gym or pool now so they can go when it is less crowded (US-21, FR-AMN-07).

requirements.title: See same-floor neighbours' names
requirements.description: A Resident can see the names of same-floor neighbours without phone numbers being shared (US-22, FR-NBR-01).

requirements.title: Admin grants approval rights to committee members
requirements.description: A Raghuvir Admin can give approval rights to any committee member so work continues even if the Secretary is busy (US-23, FR-CUS-02).
